sources.title: Aeneas: Rust Verification by Functional Translation
sources.role: Defines Aeneas's ownership-centric functional LLBC semantics and LLBC-to-pure-lambda-calculus translation; motivates backward functions and the proof-ergonomics tradeoff.

sources.title: Sound Borrow-Checking for Rust via Symbolic Semantics
sources.role: Provides the operational/simulation side of the Aeneas story: LLBC as a correct view of a lower-level pointer model, symbolic semantics as an abstraction, and borrow-checking/non-stuckness results.
Composes pass simulations and states whole-compiler backward semantic simulation.
States behavior preservation/refinement consequences from source C semantics to generated assembly semantics.
Defines traces and external-call semantics used by CompCert languages, illustrating that operational semantics can retain nondeterministic environmental behavior.
Current corpus authority for the precise scope and trust boundary of the 2022 and 2024 Aeneas formal results.
Current corpus authority for the concrete generated Lean interface of the Aeneas revision selected by Anneal.
